caption: The drawing displays six rectangular panels arranged in two columns and three rows, each containing a different repeating pattern. In the top-left panel, there is a design of thick, interwoven bands shaded in tones of pink, red, and light peach. The top-right panel has a purple background with rows of intricate geometric patterns and small black-and-white motifs resembling birds or insects. The middle-left panel features a mauve background with thin white branch-like lines and small white flowers with red centers scattered across the surface. The middle-right panel consists of geometric shapes in muted purple and red with white accents, including angular forms and lines forming fish-like motifs, presented in rows. The bottom-left panel depicts a textured, crosshatched purple background with three white flowers with red details positioned towards the lower left and center. The bottom-right panel shows a dark purple background filled with small white diamond shapes and evenly spaced diagonal rows of small geometric symbols in white.
